GMBC Wednesday Evening Training Ride

South Burlington, VT · Road

GMBC Wednesday Evening Training Ride is a road group ride in South Burlington, VT. Schedule: Wednesday evenings; start time varies through the season and is sent to the club email list, from Wheeler Dirt Lot. About 28 miles, groups by average speed, 15 mph minimum.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the start time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 15 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It splits into pace groups. Pick the slowest one your first time; you can move up next week.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the GMBC Wednesday Evening Training Ride group ride

A 28-mile loop through Shelburne and Charlotte with about 1,150 feet of climbing. Groups of twelve or fewer form by speed; the fastest starts first. Faster groups may not wait. The last group regroups and tries not to leave anyone. You need to hold 15 mph to fit in.
